content: Templo juchutsishga cananpag cashganta Jesucristo wilashgan
Templupita yargurirna juc discïpulun Jesusta caynog nergan: “¡Cuyaylapag jatusag rumicunawanmi templuntsita sharcatsipäcushga, tayta!”
Tsaynog niptin Jesús caynog nergan: “Cay lapan ricaycashgayqui cuyaylapag caycaptinpis chipyagmi juchutsishga cangapag. Manami ni juc rumilapis canan pergaraycashgannöga quëdangapagtsu.”
Manarag cutimuptin imanog cananpag cashgantapis Jesucristo nishgan
Templo tsimpan Olivos lömacho jamapagnogmi Pedro, Santiago, Juan y Andrés Jesusta tapupäcorgan caynog nir:
“Nishgayquinöga ¿imaytag templo juchutsishga canga, tayta? Tsaynog cananpäga ¿puntata imatag canga?”
Tsaynog tapuptinmi Jesús caynog nergan: “Pipis lutanta mana criyitsishunayquipag shumag tantyacäriy.
Atscagmi shapäcamonga: ‘Nogaga Cristumi caycä’ nir. Tsaynog nirmi atsca runacunata engañangapag.
May-tsay nacioncunachöpis guërra captin y wanutsinacuy captin ama mantsacärinquitsu. Puntataga tsaycunaragmi pasanga. Tsaynog captinpis cay patsa manaragmi ushacangaragtsu.
Juc nacionwan juc nacionmi pelyapäconga. Tsaynoglami muchuypis terremötupis may-tsaycho cangapag. Tsaynog captinpis nacaycuna galaycunalanragmi tsaycunaga canga.

Nogata chasquicamashgayquipitami autoridäcunamanpis prësu tsarircur apapäcushunqui. Israel mayiquicunapis contrayqui sharcur sinagogancunacho astashunquipag. Nación mandag reycunamanpis apapäcushunqui juzgashga canayquipag. Tsaychömi wilacuynëta paycunatapis wilapanquipag.
Tsaynogpami cay patsa manarag ushacaptin may-tsay nacionchöpis nogapita wilacärengapag.
“Autoridäcunaman entregapäcushuptiquipis ama laquicärinquitsu: ‘¿Imatarag nishag?’ nishpayqui. Paycunapa naupancho imata ninayquipagpis Santu Espiritumi tantyatsishunquipag.

Nogata chasquicamashganpita chiquirmi wauguintapis autoridäcunaman entreganga wanutsishga cananpag. Waquinnami tsurinta entreganga wanutsishga cananpag y waquinnami taytantapis entreganga wanutsishga cananpag.
Nogata chasquicamashgayquipitami pï-maypis chiquishunquipag. Tsaynog captinpis hasta wanunayquiyag noga munashgänog cawarmi Tayta Diospa naupanman chayanquipag.”
Fiyupa nacaycuna cananpag cashganta Jesucristo tantyatsishgan
“[Tayta Diosnintsipa profëtan Daniel escribishgannoglami] Diosta mana cäsucog runa templo ruriman yaycongapag. (Cay escribishgäta liyeg cäga shumag tantyacutsun.)
Tsay fiyu runa templuman yaycuptin Jerusalén marcapita y Judea provinciacho caycag waquin marcacunapitapis gueshpir aywacäritsun.
Wayi janancho cagcunapis
jucla gueshpir aywacutsun. Imata jorgunanpagpis wayinman amana yaycutsuntsu.
Chacrancho caycagcunapis jucla gueshpir aywacutsun. Ama cutitsuntsu wayinman trucacunanpag röpata jorgogpis.
Tsaynog gueshpirmi pasaypa cuyapaypag nacanga chichu warmicuna y iti wawayog warmicunapis.
Tamya quillacho tsay gueshpinayqui junag mana cananpag Tayta Diosnintsita manacäriy.

“Tsay junagcunaga fiyupami runacuna nacangapag. Cay patsata Tayta Diosnintsi camashganpita-patsa manami imaypis tsaynöga runacuna nacashgatsu. Tsaynogpis yapayga mananami tsaynog nacaycuna cangapagnatsu.
Acrashgancunata cuyaparmi tsay nacaycunata Tayta Diosnintsi pasatsenga. Tsay nacay junagcunata mana pasatsiptenga lapanpis wanupäcunmanmi.
Tsay junagcuna: ‘Tayta Dios cachamushgan Cristo caychömi wacchömi caycan’ nishuptiquipis ama criyipäcunquitsu.

Tsaynogpis waquenga: ‘Tayta Dios cachamushgan Cristumi caycä’ o ‘Tayta Diosnintsipa profëtanmi caycä’ nir lulacushpanmi puripäcongapag. Runacunata criyitsinan cashgami ima milagrucunatapis ruranga. Atsca runacunata tsaynogpa engañarpis Tayta Diosman yäracogcunataga manami engañayta camäpacongatsu.
Tsaycuna manarag captinmi gamcunata wilaycä tsay lutan yachatsicogcunata mana chasquipänayquipag.”
Jesucristo cay patsaman cutimunanpag cashgan
“Cay patsacho fiyupa nacaycuna pasariptinragmi intipis y quillapis tsacacäconga.
Tsaynoglami lapan estrellacunapis shicwamonga y ciëlupis sicsicyanga.
Tsaychömi nogata ricapäcamanga pucutay janancho chip-chipyaycar aywaycämogta.
Tsay junagmi angilnëcunata cachamushag may-tsaypitapis nogaman yäracamagcunata shuntamunanpag.
Hïgus yöraman tincutsir imay cutimunanpag cashgantapis Jesucristo tantyatsishgan
“Cay yachatsishgäta shumag tantyapäcuy. Tamya tiempo galaycuptin musyapäcunquimi hïgus yöra tsintsimunanpag cashganta.
Tsaynoglami tsay nishgä nacaycuna chämuptin gamcunapis musyanquipag cutimunäpagna caycashgäta.
Canan cawaycag runacuna manarag wanuptinmi lapan tsay nishgäcuna cumplengapag.
Jana patsa y cay patsa ushacaptinpis noga nishgäcunaga lapanmi cumplengapag.
Jesucristo imay höra cutimunanpag cashganta pipis mana musyashgan
“Imay junag imay höra cutimunäpag cashgantaga manami angilcunapis ni nogapis musyätsu. Tsaytaga Tayta Dioslami musyan.
Gamcunapis camaricushgala car [Tayta Diosta imaypis manacurcaycay]. Manami musyapäcunquitsu imay cutimunäpag cashgantapis.”

Tsaymi mastapis Jesús caynog nergan: “Juc wayiyog aywacur wayinta ricananpag ashmayninta cachapan imata rurananpag cagtapis tantyarcatsir. Puncu quichapagnintapis tantyatsin imay hörapis mayag mayagla caycänanpag.

Tsaynoglami nogapis elagpita cutimushag: patsa tsacaycashgan höra, pulan pagas höra, walpa wagay höra o patsa waraycashgan hörapis. Tsaynog caycaptenga shuyarpaycämanqui camaricushgala. Manami musyapäcunquitsu imay höra cutimunäpag cashgantapis.
Mayag mayagla caycaptiquega elagpita shamur jutsa ruraycagta manami tarishayquitsu.
Manami gamcunalatatsu caynog niycä, sinöga lapan runacunatami. Tsaynog wilaycaptëga mayag mayagla carcaycay.”

footnotes.text: “Cay escribishgäta liyeg cäga shumag tantyacutsun” nishganga cay libruta escribeg Marcos yapashganmi caycan.
Israel nacioncho tsay witsan wayita gatananpa trucanga terrädo jananman tsaglarcurmi mituta lashtapäcog. Tsay jananchönami warmicuna y runacuna awacäreg, agacäreg y trïgutapis acrapäcog.
